system.description:
Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

You crouch beside the overturned cup. A clean crescent in the dust tells you where the missing chair stood.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Time
Ten minutes.
Target / range / shape
One accessible scene or evidence-bearing object.
Type
Skill / Utility

Choose a question about what happened here and make a Reason roll. The DA answers from the surviving evidence.

Weak
Learn one relevant detail and what it supports.
Standard
Also learn which part of that account remains uncertain and where you could investigate it.
Strong
Also learn whether a specific explanation you propose fits all the evidence examined.

Source: design/cards/read-the-remains.md at 25b80c9fe77d7baaec3f3a8a548c9663d0f39a30.
